en: A colorized photograph of a Chinese family standing on the steps of a wooden building. Three children in bright traditional clothing and headpieces stand to the left, while an older man in dark traditional attire and a hat stands on the right holding a baby dressed in yellow and white. The scene is framed like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard with printed captions along the margins and at the bottom.
